probes.name: Voyager 1
probes.about: Interstellar probe launched 1977; flew past Jupiter (1979) and Saturn (1980); left the heliosphere in 2012. The most distant human-made object.

probes.name: Voyager 2
probes.about: Launched 1977; the only spacecraft to visit Uranus (1986) and Neptune (1989); entered interstellar space in 2018.

probes.name: New Horizons
probes.about: Flew past Pluto and Charon in July 2015 and Arrokoth in 2019; now in the Kuiper belt.

probes.name: Parker Solar Probe
probes.about: Flies through the Sun's corona; at closest approach (6.1 million km) it is the fastest human-made object (~190 km/s).

probes.name: Europa Clipper
probes.about: Launched 2024; arrives at Jupiter in 2030 to study the ocean world Europa.

probes.name: Juice
probes.about: ESA's JUpiter ICy moons Explorer; launched 2023, arrives at Jupiter in 2031 to study Ganymede, Callisto and Europa.

probes.name: Lucy
probes.about: Tours the Trojan asteroids that share Jupiter's orbit (2027-2033).

probes.name: Psyche
probes.about: Heading for the metal-rich asteroid 16 Psyche (arrival 2029).

probes.name: James Webb Space Telescope
probes.about: Infrared space telescope orbiting the Sun-Earth L2 point, 1.5 million km from Earth.

orbiters.name: International Space Station
orbiters.about: Crewed laboratory in low Earth orbit since 1998, ~420 km up, one orbit every ~93 minutes.

orbiters.name: Hubble Space Telescope
orbiters.about: Optical space telescope in low Earth orbit since 1990, ~520 km up.
